name: verify-release-tag
description: Read-only GitHub Action that verifies release tag consistency.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vitest.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vitest.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
